description: Record what a domain should show from outside and check it now — HSTS or another header present, DMARC enforcing, an issue key no longer reported, an HTTP or TLS grade at or above a level, a certificate with enough days left, a DNS record present, absent or containing a value, HTTPS answering. DechoNet reads the domain fresh (not from cache) with its public dns / ssl / http / email tools, from its own servers and the Seoul observation point, and then re-checks the set every day. Each result is pass, fail or unknown; unknown (a tool or part of it did not answer) is never a pass. Without an API key the set is anonymous: no alerts, kept 30 days after its last check, reachable by id and status page. With an API key (Authorization: Bearer dn_…) the set belongs to that key's account, and a set that held and stops holding is reported in the account's daily mail. Not read-only (it stores the set); public checks only, so any domain is accepted. Typical use: after changing DNS, TLS, headers or mail settings, to state the intended result and be told if it is ever reverted. Returns the set id, status page, per-check results with where to fix what does not hold (for the platform the site runs on), and signed observation receipts.

domain.description: Domain the checks are about (e.g. 'example.com'); scheme and path are stripped

items.description: One check. Kinds: issue_absent {tool: dns|ssl|http|email, key: issue key such as 'http_no_csp'} · grade_at_least {tool: http|ssl, value: 'A+'..'F'} · header_present {name, contains?} · https_ok {} (final status 2xx/3xx) · dns_record {type: A|AAAA|CNAME|MX|NS|TXT|CAA, op: present|absent|contains, value?} · dmarc_policy {value: ['quarantine','reject']} · cert_days_left {value: days}.

contains.description: Substring the header value must contain (header_present)

key.description: Issue key for issue_absent (as the tools report them)

value.description: Grade, record text, DMARC policies or days, depending on the check

label.description: Optional short name for the set (shown on its page and in the mail)

name: set_expectations

expiresAt.description: Anonymous sets: removed after this unless checked again

owner.description: 'account' (alerts by the API key account's daily mail) or 'anonymous' (no alerts)

receipts.description: Signed observation receipts behind this result, one per lookup: when, from where and under which rules version DechoNet observed it. Each url shows the record and checks its Ed25519 signature.

fix.description: Where to fix a check that does not hold, for the platform the site runs on

state.description: 'pass' (every check holds) | 'fail' (at least one does not) | 'unknown' (some could not be read — not a pass)

stored.description: Whether DechoNet keeps re-checking this set daily

url.description: Status page of the set: last results and recent checks

title: Set Outside Expectations (daily re-check)
